target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/shadow_frontier/notes && pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode faithfulness.tex >/tmp/ff2.log 2>&1; pdflatex -interaction=nonstopmode faithfulness.tex >/tmp/ff2.log 2>&1; grep -cE "^!" /tmp/ff2.log; pdfinfo faithfulness.pdf | grep Pages; rm -f faithfulness.aux faithfulness.log faithfulness.out
cd /home/john/mynotes && git add shadow_frontier/notes/faithfulness.tex shadow_frontier/notes/faithfulness.pdf && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
faithfulness note: the blind spot itself constrains the profile

New section: the residual N in Z_2 is not inert - three further
constraints on any counterexample:
(i) FINITE-SEED DETERMINISM: after B_n+1 > log2(x0) bits the class
    pins x0 and every later letter is forced by the x3 carry cascade;
    free phase ~ (2/3)log2(x0) steps; K(word) <= log2(x0)+O(1) while
    rigidity forces near-maximal factor complexity. Champions spend
    59-76% of their survival in the forced regime (27: 13/17 forced;
    687871: 33/50). Scheduler-adversary budget = log2(x0) bits, then
    zero choices.
(ii) COUNTABILITY: integer-realizable words = countable computable
    family emitted by one finite transducer; of 2^30 depth-30
    {1,2}-words, 66 are realized below 10^6. Machine-style attacks
    (LTE round chain, 3-smooth cascade) are the GENERAL case.
(iii) Fifth interface candidate: Stewart-type effective digit-counting
    theorems against late-time ghost alignment in the forced regime.
Caveat recorded: no measure-theoretic exclusion power (cannot
Borel-Cantelli a computable point) - consistent with the pointwise
wall; the gain is structural profile-shrinkage.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -1 && git push origin main 2>&1 | tail -1
cd shadow_frontier && ailog add --tool claude-code --level-hint 2 --text "BLIND-SPOT CONSTRAINTS section added to faithfulness.tex (pushed). The residual N-in-Z2 further constrains the profile: (i) finite-seed determinism - letters forced once B_n+1 > log2 x0; free phase 2/3 log2 x0 steps; K(word) <= log2 x0 + O(1) vs near-maximal factor complexity; champions 59-76% forced-regime survival (27: 13/17; 687871: 33/50); adversary budget = log2 x0 bits then zero choices. (ii) countability: realizable words countable + computable from one finite carry transducer; 66 of 2^30 depth-30 words realized below 10^6; machine attacks (LTE cascade) are the general case. (iii) fifth interface candidate: Stewart effective binary-digit counts of 3^n against late ghost alignment. Caveat: no measure-theoretic power (pointwise wall unchanged); gain = structural profile shrinkage continuum -> output set of one finite machine." 2>&1 | tail -1 && ailog validate 2>&1 | tail -1
